[[Stygian Scepter]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[wand]] dropped by [[Smothering Tendrils]], [[foe]]s in [[Stygian Veil]].

==Stats==
:[[Lightning damage]]: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Spawning Power]])
:Halves skill recharge of [[spell]]s (Chance: 10%)
:Halves casting time of [[spell]]s (Chance: 10%)

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Plagueborn Scepter]].

==Replica==
Except for the visual appearance, it is possible to create an exact technical replica for this item with:
*One of the following [[Spawning Power]] [[wand]]s:
**[[Ritualist Scepter]] from crafters [[Asa]], [[Derrick]], [[Hadusi]], [[Shausha]], [[Soros]], or [[Tehshan]]
**[[Asuran Scepter]] from crafter [[Nojj]]
**[[Balthazar's Rod]] from collector [[Zaishen Spirit Weapon Master]]
**[[Deldrimor Scepter]] from crafter [[Grand Mason Stonecleaver]]
**[[Fan of Purity]] from collector [[Iza Yoi]]
**[[Norn Scepter]] from crafter [[Keti]]
**[[Oppressor's Scepter]] from collector [[Lionguard (collector)|Lionguard]]
**[[Charr Scepter]] from collector [[Tuomas]] (requires [[Bonus Mission Pack]])
**[[Mursaat Scepter]] from collector [[Diane]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
**[[Tengu Scepter]] from collector [[Akemi]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
**[[Undead Scepter]] from collector [[Archivist of Whispers]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
*[[Perfect]] [[Staff Wrapping]] [[of Quickening]]
*[[Perfect]] "[[Inscription|Don't Think Twice]]" inscription

==Unique counterparts==
*[[Kaolin Wand]] has stats identical to this item.
*The [[Spawning Power]] version of [[Droknar's Scepter]] has stats identical to this item.
